title: Charting the Wicked Years Chronologically
text: Charting the Wicked Years Chronologically “Oh, as to time, well, no one in Oz ticks off tocks very systematically.” Each dot or upstroke represents a year … more or less. WICKED OUT OF OZ The story begins six months after the end of A LION AMONG MEN. Liir is about 30; Rain is 7 or 8, give or take.
